title: Check decoding by enumerating paths
description: You compare exhaustive path calculations with Viterbi and forward results.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You score one concrete path by adding initial, transition, and emission log probabilities. Each observation contributes through its path state.
You enumerate every length-T state sequence and retain the highest joint log probability. This gives an exhaustive best-path comparison.

steps.question: Does the recorded exhaustive search agree with the Viterbi path?
steps.answer: Yes. Both select Sunny, Rainy, Rainy, and the comparison prints True.

steps.description: You enumerate the paths again and combine their log probabilities with logsumexp. This sums path probabilities to obtain the observation-sequence likelihood.
You compare that exact sum with the stored forward result. Both recorded log likelihoods equal -3.3928721329161653, and the tolerance check prints True.
